query: graph_mem project architecture, MCP toolset, and summarization
summary:
graph_mem is a Rails 8+ backend for graph-based memory. Its persisted model is an entity graph: MemoryEntity nodes have observations, and MemoryRelation stores typed source-to-target links. MCP actions are individual fast-mcp DSL classes under app/tools, with related MCP resources for entities, observations, and relations.

The current graph captures trust ranking and contradiction detection, while guidance requires source-backed summaries, explicit observation lifecycle/supersession, context boosting rather than hard filtering, and bounded traversal. Phase 5 implemented hybrid summarization: deterministic active-evidence selection is always available; optional Ollama synthesis is configured through AppSettings; and provider failure falls back to deterministic output. The embedding model remains retrieval-only rather than a text-generation model.

This manual fixture excludes unrelated project-level semantic matches returned by the broad query and retains only graph_mem-rooted evidence and directly related components.

[2026-07-15] Phase 5 summarization design recommendation: keep the existing embedding model for retrieval only; embeddings produce vectors, not fluent summaries. For a 15 GB RAM laptop, start with a separate Ollama instruct model such as qwen3:8b-q4_K_M (~5.2 GB) or gemma3:12b-it-q4_K_M (~8.1 GB), with gemma3:4b (~3.3 GB) as the faster fallback. Deterministic extractive summaries remain useful as a no-LLM, auditable fallback and baseline; a hybrid design can return extractive evidence plus optional LLM synthesis.
